name: Eval a prompt change (A/B replay + blinded judge)
description: Measure a change to CONVENTIONS.md, the verifier prompt or a persona before it ships (P2-1). Picks 5 historical done tasks of the target family (a division or agent slug), replays each under variant A and variant B in sandboxed artifact dirs (no publishing, pushes or credentials; outward CLIs are blocked and logged), then ONE judge from a different model family than the executor (P1-1 mapping) scores both sets against a fixed rubric in a single blinded pass. Output: eval-report.md with per-task scores and Δ(A−B). Convention: A = the new text, B = the current/old text, so a positive Δ means the change helps. Variant paths are absolute or relative to the cowork repo root. All steps run on the exec:script brain local-script-eval-harness (node dist/eval-cli.js step).

steps.title: Eval {{family}}: pick 5 historical done tasks
steps.description:
Select 5 replayable done tasks of family "{{family}}" from the inbox (seeded by the run id, recurring titles counted once, no Continue:/input-file tasks) and write selection.json.
EVAL_ARGS: {"family": "{{family}}", "n": "5"}
acceptance: selection.json lists 5 tasks whose division or agent is {{family}}

steps.title: Eval {{family}}: SANDBOX REPLAY with variant A
steps.description:
SANDBOX REPLAY — do not perform outward actions. Replay each selected task under variant A ({{variantA}}) on the family's executor brain, one sandbox dir per task, secrets stripped, commit/push/publish CLIs blocked and logged; snapshot every workspace repo and the task list before/after.
EVAL_ARGS: {"family": "{{family}}", "variantA": "{{variantA}}", "variantB": "{{variantB}}", "executor": "auto", "timebox": "12", "concurrency": "3"}

forbid: git commit / git push / git tag in any real repo
gh, vercel, wrangler, docker push, npm publish or any publish/deploy CLI
POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE to external or cowork APIs (no task creation)
posting, uploading or sending anything to any platform
reading or using credentials (~/.priv, ~/.ssh, tokens, browser profiles)

acceptance: its sandbox check shows no repo changes and no tasks created

steps.title: Eval {{family}}: SANDBOX REPLAY with variant B
steps.description:
SANDBOX REPLAY — do not perform outward actions. Replay each selected task under variant B ({{variantB}}) on the same executor brain, one sandbox dir per task, secrets stripped, commit/push/publish CLIs blocked and logged; snapshot every workspace repo and the task list before/after.
EVAL_ARGS: {"family": "{{family}}", "variantA": "{{variantA}}", "variantB": "{{variantB}}", "executor": "auto", "timebox": "12", "concurrency": "3"}

forbid: git commit / git push / git tag in any real repo
gh, vercel, wrangler, docker push, npm publish or any publish/deploy CLI
POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE to external or cowork APIs (no task creation)
posting, uploading or sending anything to any platform
reading or using credentials (~/.priv, ~/.ssh, tokens, browser profiles)

acceptance: its sandbox check shows no repo changes and no tasks created

steps.title: Eval {{family}}: blinded cross-family judge + eval-report.md
steps.description:
One judge brain from a different model family than the executor (P1-1 judge mapping) scores all 10 results in a single pass, X/Y labels shuffled per task, against the fixed rubric (completion, evidence, honesty, scope, clarity; 0-5 each). Unblind, compute Δ(A−B) and write eval-report.md + scores.json.
EVAL_ARGS: {"judge": "auto"}
acceptance: eval-report.md exists with per-task A/B scores, Δ(A−B) and the outward-action check
